subject: Logic
title: The Red Herring
description: A 60-second lesson on The Red Herring.

hook.text: "Why were you late?" "Well, traffic is terrible in this city in general." Notice the dodge?

buildup.text: A red herring introduces an irrelevant topic to divert attention from the original issue.

discovery.text: The name comes from using smoked fish to throw hunting dogs off a scent trail.

twist.text: Politicians master this: asked about budget cuts, they pivot to national security. Subject changed.

climax.text: Spot it by asking: does this response actually address the original question? If not, redirect.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a red herring?
options: To divert attention from the issue
